subject: CLAIM+ABI shader-coverage-opus (root handoff): air_bridge.rs compute create path (compile_compute_creation + NEW tegu_air_pipeline_create_ex) and air_bridge.h additive decls; texture-opus variant/sampled_format regions untouched
body:
Proposed additive C ABI (air_bridge.h), api-surface please ACK or amend before wiring compute_frontend.m:
typedef struct {const TeguAIRLibrary *library;const uint8_t *name;size_t name_len;uint32_t list,reserved;} TeguAIRLinkedFunction; /* list: 0 functions, 1 privateFunctions, 2 binaryFunctions; library may differ from the kernel's (each MTLFunction's own library handle); name = MTLFunction.name */
typedef struct {uint32_t version;            /* 1 */
 uint32_t max_call_stack_depth;              /* 0 = Metal default 1 */
 const TeguAIRLinkedFunction *linked;size_t linked_count;   /* MTLLinkedFunctions; function tables need the table's functions in list 0 or 2 */
 const TeguAIRVertexAttribute *stage_attributes;size_t stage_attribute_count; /* stageInputDescriptor.attributes: index,MTLAttributeFormat,offset,bufferIndex */
 const TeguAIRVertexLayout *stage_layouts;size_t stage_layout_count;          /* layouts: bufferIndex,stride,MTLStepFunction (incl. ThreadPositionInGridX..=5..8),stepRate */
 uint32_t stage_index_type,stage_index_buffer_index;                          /* MTLIndexType, indexBufferIndex */
 uint32_t has_stage_input,reserved;} TeguAIRComputeCreateOptions;
TeguAIRPipeline *tegu_air_pipeline_create_ex(const TeguAIRLibrary *,const uint8_t *name,size_t,const TeguAIRComputeCreateOptions *,const uint8_t *profile,size_t,TeguAIRBlob *spirv,TeguAIRBlob *metadata,char *,size_t);
Same outputs/handle as tegu_air_pipeline_create (limits/dispatchable/plan/native dispatch unchanged); options NULL == tegu_air_pipeline_create exactly. Function-constant-specialized linked functions: pass a handle from tegu_air_library_specialize. Caveat from the corpus: the MPS kernels reference specializedName symbols (prefixPrimary_f, prefixPrimary_4xf...) that exist in no installed metallib by that name - they are MTLFunctionDescriptor.specializedName results; the translator links by function name, so supporting MPS also needs a specializedName alias (translator change, I will look at it after this export).
